experimental_auto.purpose: Real-device MPC experiment tracking the red fish with the current best camera/body and three-axis dynamic candidates; detector confidence remains disabled, while the existing depth-quality, innovation, range and motion gates are enabled after the 2026-08-13 outlier-driven control test.
experimental_auto.vision_source_access: read_only_tail; MPC must not modify or operate the tracking_depth repository
experimental_auto.validated_limit_basis: The physical mapping evidence ends at absolute channel 0.10. After the 0.35 translation experiment remained too fast to brake, the operator requested lower authority and faster relative braking on 2026-08-13. The active experimental forward/right/down envelope is 0.20 and the firmware final-motor envelope remains 0.50; the range above 0.10 is an uncalibrated experimental extension, not a validated force range. Direct yaw is not used by the selected translation model.
arming_sequence: accepted disarmed zero establishes a new random command session
fresh telemetry, execution feedback and confirmed vision are required
armed zero must be positively acknowledged before the first MPC command
experimental_auto.latched_stop_policy: Only a visual coordinate accepted by the configured depth-quality, innovation, range and motion gates updates MPC; detector confidence itself remains disabled. During an empty, rejected or stale visual interval, translation is rate-limited toward the fixed Fossen balance force tau_h; yaw stays in lower-controller local hold and the lower controller continues local roll/pitch stabilization; AUTO remains active. Telemetry/failsafe, command rejection/stale confirmation, transport failure or MPC fallback still sends disarmed zero and stops.
known_risks: The 20260812 dynamic and 20260813 rigid camera/body rotations differ by 7.036 deg; the dynamic candidate is selected for this experiment because it has 632 inliers and lower 0.02698 m combined RMSE.
The CAD camera origin is used; the approximate tag-height rigid fit differs from it by 0.0724 m.

Sway is not window-invariant under the current tethered test; the older multi-amplitude mass candidate and the corrected-pose forced-window damping candidate are combined as an engineering experimental model.
Heave uses positive down pulses plus natural upward coast; negative-thrust asymmetry and individual vertical load-cell curves were not measured.

The operator-authorized controller can saturate any translation axis at 0.20 and any final motor at 0.50, while physical RPM/force mapping has only been measured through 0.10; translation force conversion above 0.10 uses a linear 2-times envelope approximation.

Optional direct-yaw inertia/damping and host cascaded-PID gains remain experimental candidates, but direct yaw is not used by the selected translation model. Unknown roll/pitch PID demand is not predicted.

actuator_model.basis: real M1..M8 force directions, same-vehicle force-limit priors and CAD-origin yaw arms; planar force+yaw only

control.mpc_final_motor_limit_method: operator-authorized 50-percent final mixed-motor envelope: uniformly scale all eight mixed outputs only above 0.50 to preserve the combined wrench direction, followed by an independent per-motor hard clamp; direct calibration remains limited to 0.10
control.mpc_attitude_feedback_frame: body FRD; measured raw IMU roll/pitch/yaw and gyro x/y/z signs are all negated before the local attitude controller
control.local_pitch_mixer_sign: reversed from the pre-20260813 matrix using the second water test: positive reconstructed pitch correction drove FRD pitch from approximately -1.2 deg to -10 deg instead of restoring it
control.local_attitude_gain_validation: Roll, pitch and yaw were isolated with firmware single-axis modes, then re-checked together in water. With all three low-gain loops active, no motor reached the 10% limit; horizontal yaw motor output fell from old-gain P95 5.06% / max 7.75% to P95 0% / max 1.01%.
control.local_attitude_state_initialization: All Matrixf controller states are explicitly initialized with matrixf::zeros. Matrixf's default constructor does not clear its backing array; leaving targetAttitude roll/pitch uninitialized caused reset-dependent positive feedback.
control.imu_stale_behavior: keep AUTO and MPC armed state unchanged; suppress and reset only the local roll/pitch/yaw feedback controllers until fresh IMU packets resume; translation commands continue
control.calibration_channel_step_enable_basis: Corrected M1/M2/M6/M7 horizontal and M3/M4/M5/M8 vertical mixer firmware, FRD attitude-feedback signs, pressure-sensor-0 selection, and final MPC motor limiter flashed and verified; post-flash disarmed zero-output log passed.

heave_down.test_method: Two repetitions each at +0.05 and +0.075 down channel for 2 s, followed by zero-command natural upward coast. Surface-constrained samples after the first return through pre-pulse depth are excluded.
